payload.friendly_name: Approval honesty: no fabricated reviewer or review cycle
payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Approval honesty: no fabricated reviewer or review cycle on fix/3044-approval-honesty so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
payload.purpose_tldr: Approvals recorded by move-task carry the real reviewer, one review is one cycle, and cited cycles must exist.

payload.question: Which issues and related surfaces does the mission fold in?

payload.final_answer: Core #7569/#7571/#7570/#7573 + FOLD #6709; #3451 folds only if reproduced on main with the same cause; in scope also policy_metadata.tool, core spk-run-verdict-capture skill and runtime-next approve hint. Refs #3044, #5721, #5543 (partly fixed), #3158. Follow-up issues: done_bookkeeping synthetic refs/git actor, status emit + orchestrator-api asserted-reviewer doors, open-packs review prompt.
payload.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12 on research escalation (recommended option).

payload.question: What does an approval record when move-task has no reviewer identity?

payload.final_answer: Asserted identity or refuse: reviewer = --reviewer/--agent, else the in_review claimant; never git user.name, never a synthetic token. Unforced approval with no identity refuses with a new refusal code. Forced approval records the forcing actor with the existing force-override reference. No events-schema change.
payload.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12; null reviewer needs a spec-kitty-events release (ReviewVerdict.reviewer min_length=1 + 4 core validators).

payload.question: How is an approver differing from the in_review claimant handled (#7573)?

payload.final_answer: Refuse: an unforced in_review->approved must come from the in_review claimant; otherwise refuse with a new code whose remedy re-claims via agent action review <WP> --agent <id>. Forced moves stay possible and are recorded as forced, never as a review.

payload.question: How are duplicate cycles (#7571) and uncited cycles (#7570) fixed?

payload.final_answer: Adopt + verify: adopt an approved review-cycle artifact written after the current in_review claim instead of writing N+1; otherwise write as today. A review-cycle:// --approval-ref or a note citing cycle N must resolve to an existing artifact, else refuse naming the missing path. No backfill of append-only event logs; follow-up issue for a doctor/flag report.

payload.question: APPROVER_NOT_CLAIMANT remedy, given re-claim by another identity is refused as a claim collision?

payload.final_answer: Remedy: the claimant records the verdict (--agent <claimant>), or the operator uses --force (recorded as a forced move, never a review). No new handoff path. Supersedes the re-claim remedy of decision claimant_mismatch.
payload.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12; no in_review->for_review edge and reviewer-role claims collide.

payload.question: Post-claim review-cycle-N.md that is invalid or attributed to another identity?

payload.final_answer: Refuse unforced approval with REVIEW_CYCLE_NOT_ADOPTABLE naming the file and the canonical route (review-feedback-N.md + --review-feedback-file).

APPROVER_NOT_CLAIMANT, REVIEW_CYCLE_CITATION_MISSING, REVIEW_CYCLE_NOT_ADOPTABLE; exit 1; no SINGLE_BRANCH alias; ADR 2026-10-04-5 amendment. --reviewer is a strict identity assertion: sets the actor when --agent is absent; must equal --agent and the claimant.

payload.question: How are #7573 and the residuals handled?

payload.final_answer: Close #7569/#7570/#7571/#7573 for the recording side; residuals (--force route counted by approved_bound = #5721 route a, auto-walk self-claim, impersonation, pre-existing override-persist timing) documented in the ADR amendment and PR handoff; Refs #5721; follow-up issues filed.

payload.question: Which in_review entry is the review claimant?

payload.final_answer: The newest UNFORCED non-migration entry into in_review whose actor is not a generic placeholder (same rule as consolidation's approved_bound._entered_review_by_claim); implemented once in status/review_roles.py. A forced or placeholder entry yields no claimant, so no claimant refusal applies.
payload.rationale: Agent design call: single authority with consolidation; re-pins the 4670 fixture that seeds its claim with force=True.

payload.question: What does approved->done carry when the recorded approval predates the fix?

payload.final_answer: Carry the recorded approval's reviewer and reference verbatim (an honest copy of history, C-002); if no readable approval exists, the asserted --agent with force-override, else refuse with the existing placeholder refusal. Never the git user.
payload.rationale: Agent design call: the fabrication happened at the old approval; rewriting it would violate append-only history.

payload.question: How is an adoptable post-claim review cycle identified?

payload.final_answer: Valid artifact, referenced by no status event, cycle number greater than every cycle number referenced by the event log, reviewer_agent identity-equal to the reviewer of record; never with --review-feedback-file (#6652 leg writes as today). Frontmatter has no verdict field, so rejection cycles are excluded by being referenced by their rejection event.
payload.rationale: Agent design call from squad: avoids trusting reviewer-written reviewed_at timestamps.

Reviewer of record: claimant fact, combiner, honest identity
One review, one cycle; cited cycles exist

payload.question: Unforced approval on a damaged review slot (no cycle written, no honest reference)?

payload.final_answer: Refuse (fail closed, nothing written) unless --approval-ref is given; remedy names the damaged log and --force or --approval-ref. FR-012 amended for this case only; feedback-file warnings unchanged.
payload.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12 after WP01 review cycle 1 (finding 2).
